title: AvailabilityBroadcast
description: v1 — the pre-determined grammar the daemon broadcasts to the main server after storing a dataset. Lightweight announcement + integrity envelope; carries no observation values. The server accepts or rejects (see broadcast-response.schema.json); on accept the orchestrator pulls the full IndicatorDataset by datasetId.

broadcastId.description: bc-<uuid v4>. Echoed in the BroadcastResponse for correlation.

datasetId.description: The stored IndicatorDataset this broadcast announces. The orchestrator pulls by this id.

seriesIncluded.description: seriesIds present in the stored dataset, so the server can decide relevance before pulling.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical stored IndicatorDataset JSON. The server re-checks this after pulling to confirm it got what was announced.

value.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical broadcast body (all fields except signature), keyed by the shared secret. Authenticates the daemon to the main server.
